## Meta Q2 Preview: Street Expects ~$60B Revenue Ahead of July 29 Report; Stock Has Recovered from 20% Drawdown to Within 5% of Flat for the Year

META at near-flat for the year after a 20% drawdown means the stock enters earnings with sentiment reset but valuation still dependent on Q2 ad revenue trajectory and capex guidance—a beat-and-raise or miss-and-cut on either line would materially re-anchor the thesis.

- META reports Q2 earnings on July 29; consensus revenue expectation is ~$60B (per headline).
- Stock has recovered from a 20% drawdown and is now within 5% of flat for the year (per headline).
- Key event for both the ad market strength and hyperscaler capex buildout themes.
- No guidance revision or pre-announcement detail cited in the headlines.
